audit.why: HARD 8.5/10 against a 47.87% win rate over 610 games is a little heavy, but the content layer's late-game section supports it and the mirror moved its own tag rather than this one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and First item were given to Heimerdinger, contradicting the packet chart and this page's own whys.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill / Nautilus / Nautilus / Skill / Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger. whys[1] says the W shield and splash burn win the Level 2 short trade, whys[2] calls Level 3 'my cleanest window', and whys[5] says the first-item stage 'stays a skill matchup around my hook timing'. The chart rows were the half that was wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 flipped as matched pairs in both layers to Nautilus, Nautilus and Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Turret written as 'H-28G Evolution Turret' and the grenade as 'CH-2 Electron Grenade'; no Heimerdinger cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Riot names them H-28 G Evolution Turret and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. The grenade is a flat 11s and stuns only a direct hit, slowing everything around it; Hextech Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325 range, which is why a melee tank cannot poke back.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] renamed; dosFull[0].d carries the flat 11s; dontsFull[1].d states the rocket range.

edits.before: His H-28G Evolution Turret zoning is his early threat: once two turrets stack the wave, your Q has nothing to hook through and you eat W rockets for free.
edits.after: His H-28 G Evolution Turret zoning is his early threat: once two turrets stack the wave, your Q has nothing to hook through and you eat rockets for free.

edits.after: Stack two H-28 G turrets on the wave so your melee Q has no clean hook angle and the wave is walled

edits.before: Land his E (CH-2 Electron Grenade) stun the instant you Q in to cancel your all-in before the passive-root combo
edits.after: Land CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, an 11s stun, the instant you Q in to cancel the all-in before the root

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His grenade stuns on a flat 11s cooldown — engage after he spends it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units — you cannot poke back.

notes: Only a direct grenade hit stuns; the surrounding area is a slow. That is why 'dodge it' should mean 'do not be the point of impact', which the corrected dosFull[0].d implies without over-claiming.
